title: Borderline gradient continuity for degenerate/singular fully nonlinear elliptic equations with Hamiltonian terms
summary: This paper focuses on a class of fully nonlinear elliptic equations with general double phase degeneracy/singularity law and Hamiltonian terms of the form $$Φ(|Du|,x)F(D^2 u, x)+H(Du,x) =f(x) \quad \text{in} \quad B_{1},$$ where $Φ$ takes one of two typical forms: $$Φ(|Du|,x)=σ_{1}(|Du|)+a(x)σ_{2}(|Du|)\quad {\rm or}\quad Φ(|Du|,x)=\frac{σ_{1}(|Du|)}{|Du|}+a(x)\frac{σ_{2}(|Du|)}{|Du|}.$$ Under suitable assumptions on the operator $F$, Hamiltonian term $H$, source term $f$ and modulating coefficient $a$, we establish $C^{1}$ regularity for viscosity solutions, provided that $σ_{1},σ_{2}$ are…
